name: permission-request
title: Permission request
author: Eduardo Retana
description: An agent asks for one right. The card says who, why, and exactly what will happen. Allow it once, for a while, or always. A destructive ask cannot be kept forever.

meta.descriptionEs: Un agente pide un solo derecho. La tarjeta dice quién, por qué y qué va a pasar. Se permite una vez, un rato o siempre. Lo destructivo no se deja para siempre.

examples.title: Correo a Celaya
examples.description: Bruma pide mandar el pedido PED-990. Lo destructivo no ofrece siempre.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y diez filas.

meta.usage: <PermissionRequest agent={agent} action={action} risk={risk} preview={preview} scope={scope} decision={decision} onDecisionChange={setDecision} />

api.name: agent / action / target / reason
api.description: The title reads as the agent wanting the action. The reason is the agent's own words.

api.name: preview
api.description: The concrete rows: who receives it, the subject, the file. meta on a row is the side note. itemMeta is opaque.

api.name: risk / scope
api.type: safe | risky | destructive / once | timed | always
api.description: Destructive drops Always even if the host lists it.

api.name: decision / onDecisionChange
api.description: Null means it is still asking. Revoke and ask again pass null. The host stores the grant and the time left.

api.name: loading / error / labels
api.description: Skeleton, alert, and chrome copy. English is the default.

docs: Inspirado en el comportamiento público de Affect; reimplementación clean-room; no código, datos, iconos ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. No es el recibo de una herramienta: pide un derecho antes de actuar.
